rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an organized group or set of people or things.

example.english: This grouping of documents needs to be put separately.
example.jyutping: ni1 jat1 zou2 man4 gin6 jiu3 ling6 ngoi6 baai2

rows.note: Use this for a casual group of people rather than a set of objects.

example.english: That grouping of people chats downstairs every night.
example.traditional: 嗰一班人晚晚喺樓下吹水。
example.jyutping: go2 jat1 baan1 jan4 maan5 maan5 hai2 lau4 haa6 ceoi1 seoi2

rows.note: Use this especially for an online or social-media group.

example.english: I joined the grouping to get the latest updates.
example.traditional: 我加入咗個群組攞最新消息。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gaa1 jap6 zo2 go3 kwan4 zou2 lo2 zeoi3 san1 siu1 sik1

rows.note: Use this for the process or activity of dividing people or things into groups.

example.english: The teacher organized us for the homework by grouping.
example.traditional: 老師叫我哋分組做功課。
example.jyutping: lou5 si1 giu3 ngo5 dei6 fan1 zou2 zou6 gung1 fo3
